## Standing operator rules
Release acme-utils 2.8.0, in order: `git status --porcelain && python -m pytest -q`; `hatch version 2.8.0`; `python scripts/build_release_notes.py --version 2.8.0 --write`; `git add pyproject.toml CHANGELOG.md RELEASE_NOTES_2.8.0.md && git commit -m 'release: 2.8.0'`; `git tag -a v2.8.0 -m 'acme-utils 2.8.0' && git push origin v2.8.0`; `rm -rf build dist && python -m build`; `python -m twine check dist/acme_utils-2.8.0*`; `python -m twine upload dist/acme_utils-2.8.0*`; `gh release create v2.8.0 --repo acme/acme-utils --title 'acme-utils 2.8.0' --notes-file RELEASE_NOTES_2.8.0.md`.
Always run make license-check from the repository root after changing requirements/base.txt.
Paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
Use cache-eu-3 for anything staging; cache-eu-1 is being drained and must not receive writes.
Never create a service-specific Google Cloud NAT gateway for ledgerly; use the gateway named ledgerly-shared-prod-nat instead.

## Current objective
Continue search rebuild optimization; vendor-credit CSV import and release work remain paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Pool size 50: staging contention/deadlocks.
- Shared billing filter without `dest="currency"`: broke parsing.
- Per-invoice embedding: too slow.
- Retrying all `HTTPStatusError`: incorrectly retried 4xx.

## Recent work
Webhook retries and 44-test suite passed. Search embedding was concurrent and chunked; 33 index/rebuilder tests passed. A 5,000-invoice rebuild fell from 8.42s to 1.87s. PostgreSQL selected `invoices_tenant_updated_idx`; investigate remaining sequential scan/latency.
